chapter: West Coast trip and Mildred's circle
title: Miles Rinker as road manager; Mildred's closeness to him
summary: Dance mentions researching Mildred; Norvo says she was closest to Miles, who became their road manager and later worked for Cy Shribman and other bandleaders.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: HOW FUNNY. Isn't that funny. Well, you know, that's -- I did oh, I did a thing on Mildred for an encyclopedia, and -- and they asked me to, you know, check out her background and everything and I had -- I had some information and I looked -- you know, did some research. And I talked about Al Rinker, but I didn't know she -- [End of Tape I, side 1]

It -- it no. I wasn't that I was doing this piece on Mildred and just a second now -- no, that's -- so what I was saying about Mildred was just that -- I was you know, providing her background and so I was talking about Al Rinker and I never realized that she had other brothers like
NO, I didn't. Would you say Mildred was close with all her brothers?
No she -- with any of them?
She was closer, probably, to Miles, because we -- when we went to California we followed Goodman and the Palomar, and Miles was out there then --
And we brought him back East with us.
And he became our road manager for awhile. Then he -- after that --
And he came back when we were at the Commodore, in fact, he was -- he stayed with me even after we stopped working together. Mildred and I stopped working together.
Then, when she wasn't feeling well, any-
thing like that, we started -- he stayed with me.
And then after that, he worked for Cy for a number of years --
Yeah, he worked for Cy and he handled Tony Pastor's band and he worked for -- oh he worked for Glenn Miller, he worked for a lot of them --
He worked like road manager for these people.
He worked for Cy for years.
And then he went out West and he cleared some -- yeah, see they were -- they were over a quarter Indian,
And they had that land. So Miles cleared some and he sold a piece of land that they had. I know that. And he died just last year or so, when -- in Portland, Oregon.
He - he lived -- after that when I would go up to San Francisco to work, I know he was living in Oakland, he'd get in touch with me.
And this was maybe 10 years ago.
